parsed.root_cause: The Kubernetes control plane components (KubeScheduler and KubeControllerManager) have become unresponsive, causing the cluster to lose its ability to schedule pods, manage state, and collect metrics, which cascades into service failures and alerting pipeline issues.
evidence: KubeScheduler has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.
KubeControllerManager has disappeared from Prometheus target discovery.
FailedScheduling event for jaeger-traces-recorder-0 due to volume binding failure indicating scheduler inability to function.
HPA alerts showing max replicas indicate autoscaling is not adjusting pod counts due to controller manager inactivity.
PrometheusNotConnectedToAlertmanagers suggests the monitoring stack cannot communicate with the control plane.
